title: araucaria excelsa
intro: Araucaria excelsa, commonly known as Hoop Pine, is a species of coniferous tree native to Australia and New Guinea. The essential oil extracted from the leaves and bark of this plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in aromatherapy. Health benefits associated with Hoop Pine essential oil include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and act as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of Hoop Pine essential oil include alpha-pinene, beta-pinene, and myrcene, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as reducing anxiety, promoting relaxation, and fighting against infections.
